The year 2022 has been rough for the entire post-Soviet Union, but mostly Ukraine and Russia, of course. This year I left Russia and started living in Georgia, and it's been a year full of hard choices, struggle and mental health issues. In today's video I want to go over my year 2022 and talk about personal stuff, including my life at the moment, feelings about Russia and current plans for the future. Thank you guys for watching me throughout all this year and all the continued support! May there be peace in your home in 2023 and I'll be sure to provide more videos about Russia to you guys!
